CapSettings.description:
The global master Cap per kind, in ``config.toml``. Every Upstream, Proxy, and tool
inherits these, and may only lower what it inherits (global, then Upstream, then Proxy,
then tool).

tool_name.description: Ceiling on an exposed tool name, in characters.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

tool_description.description: Ceiling on an exposed tool description, in characters.
tool_description.title: Tool Description

argument_description.description: Ceiling on an exposed argument description, in characters.
argument_description.title: Argument Description

instructions.description: Ceiling on the Proxy's exposed instructions, in characters.
instructions.title: Instructions

tool_output.description: Ceiling on a tool call's answer, in characters.
tool_output.title: Tool Output

CapSettings.title: CapSettings

token.description: Bearer token every request to Proxies, the API, and the dashboard must carry. Required to bind a non-loopback host.
token.title: Token

dashboard.description: Serve the read-only dashboard at /. Off, the Daemon does not mount it at all: for a Daemon nobody browses to. Read at Daemon start.
dashboard.title: Dashboard

new_items.description: Whether items an Upstream adds later are hidden or visible once accepted.
new_items.title: New Items

LifecycleSettings.description:
When an Upstream's connection is opened, checked, and let go.

These belong to the Upstream, since the connection is the Upstream's and is shared by its
Proxies. ``config.toml`` sets the defaults; an Upstream file overrides what it cares about.

warm.description: Connect at Daemon start and ping on an interval, instead of waiting for the first call. Warm Upstreams never go idle.
warm.title: Warm

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without a call before the connection is let go. 0 keeps it forever.
idle_timeout.title: Idle Timeout

connect_timeout.description: Seconds a connect attempt may take before it counts as a failure.
connect_timeout.title: Connect Timeout

ping_interval.description: Seconds between pings of a warm Upstream, so it is never falsely reported up.
ping_interval.title: Ping Interval

backoff_cap.description: The longest wait after a failed connect before another is tried, in seconds; the wait doubles from one second up to this. A warm Upstream's keeper tries again when it has passed; a lazy Upstream's calls are answered without trying until it has.
backoff_cap.title: Backoff Cap

unavailable_message.default: The Upstream is not reachable right now, so this call did not run. Nothing changed; try again in a moment.
unavailable_message.description: The tool error a call is answered with while the Upstream is not connected.
unavailable_message.title: Unavailable Message

LifecycleSettings.title: LifecycleSettings

LogSettings.description: The app log's level, and the one size cap every log file shares.

level.description: The least severe app log level kept: debug, info, warning, or error. Verbose by default; the call log is always on whatever this says.
level.title: Level

max_bytes.description: The most the app log and the call log together may take on disk, rotated files included; the oldest rotated files go first. At the smallest value no rotated file is kept at all.
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

LogSettings.title: LogSettings

lifecycle.description: Defaults for every Upstream connection; an Upstream file may override.

caps.description: The global master Cap per kind. An Upstream, a Proxy, or a tool may only lower what it inherits.
